Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional print studio service photograph for the local AlloPrint website.
Primary request: a real-looking large-format printer producing a beautiful oversized abstract geometric poster in a bright contemporary print workshop.
Scene/backdrop: tidy professional workshop, warm off-white surfaces, unbranded graphite and silver roll-to-roll inkjet printer, paper rolls in soft background.
Subject: printer and single emerging sheet with sophisticated abstract shapes in deep petrol teal #00677a, acid lime #b9e533 and warm white. No typography on the artwork.
Style/medium: premium editorial commercial photography, believable real machinery and material textures, not a 3D render.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, three-quarter view, entire main printing area in central 75% so usable as 4:3 and portrait crops; clean balanced foreground.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, precise crisp detail on paper and print head, subtle depth of field.
Constraints: no readable words, no logos, no watermark, no people, no collage. This is an illustrative service photo, not documentary proof of a particular business.
